verdict.rationale: Codex supports signing in with a ChatGPT account under Business, Edu, or Enterprise plans, or authenticating with an API key. OpenAI's API platform adds organization- and project-scoped RBAC for managing permissions at scale. There is no evidence of enterprise SSO/SAML identity-provider login or of authenticating through a third-party cloud platform, so only the ChatGPT-account path is covered. Missing for 10: documented SSO/SAML/IdP integration, cloud-platform authentication (e.g., Azure or other cloud-provider routing), enterprise admin/provisioning details for Codex specifically, and independent corroboration.
